APP_TITLE: Ekifo Eky'enjigiriza ky'Abapainiya ba Afirika - Ebweru
WELCOME_SUB: Omulyango gw'okuzzaamu Afirika Amaanyi okuyita mu Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Mu kujaguza olunaku lwa 25 olwa Afirika, App eno ey'okutendeka Abapainiya ba Pi yatongozeddwa)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network pulojekiti ya ssente za digito n'ekitundu ky'ensi yonna ekoleddwa okusobozesa cryptocurrency okutuuka ku buli muntu n'okuba ey'omugaso.
INTRO_P2: Obutafaananako ne cryptocurrency ez'edda ezitera okwetaagisa ebyuma eby'emiwendo egy'omutendo n'amasannyalaze mangi, Pi Network esobozesa abantu ba bulijjo okwetaba butereevu ku ssimu zaabwe.
INTRO_P3: Okulaba kwa Pi Network kwe kuzimba ecosystem ekulemberwa abantu awamu ssente za digito gye ziyinza okukozesebwa ku mirimu egya nnamaddala, obuweereza obwaddala, ebibiina ebyaddala n'okwetaba mu by'enfuna ebyaddala.
GLOBAL_MISSION: Omulimu gwa Pi Network ogw'Ensi Yonna
M1: Okuzimba eby'enfuna bya digito ebigatta buli muntu
M2: Okuwa abantu ba bulijjo amaanyi mu nsi yonna
CH1_SUB: Tukwaniriza mu Kifo Eky'enjigiriza ky'Abapainiya ba Afirika - Ebweru. Omukutu guno gwakolebwa okuyigiriza, okuwa amaanyi n'okuteekateeka Abapainiya ba Afirika n'obusuubuzi okwetaba mu ngeri ey'omugaso mu Pi Ecosystem.
REG2: Weewandiise ng'okozesa Facebook oba Namba y'Essimu
DAILY_MINING: Okusima kwa buli lunaku: Dda buli ssaawa 24 okusigala ng'osima.
WALLET_SEC: Obukuumi bwa Wallet: Totangaaza bigambo byo 24 ebya Passphrase. Alina ebigambo ebyo ye nannyini wallet.
CH2_DESC: Yiga engeri y'okufuna n'okusindika Pi mu butebenkevu ng'okozesa Pi Wallet mu Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: ESSUULA 2A — OKUTENDOKA OKW'OMUGASO OKWA PI WALLET
CH2A_DESC: Tandika n'omuwendo omutono ogw'okugezesa, kebera aderesi, totangaaza passphrase yo.
CH3_DESC: Pi Browser DApps ze app ezitali wansi w'omuntu omu ezikozesebwa mu ngeri ey'omugaso.
CH4_DESC: Zuula obusuubuzi obukkiriza Pi mu nsi yonna.

FINAL_P: Afirika erina omukisa okubeera emu ku bitundu ebisinga amaanyi mu nkozesa ey'omugaso mu Pi Ecosystem. Awamu Twazimba. Awamu Tuyigiriza. Awamu Tuzzaamu Afirika Amaanyi okuyita mu Pi.
